purpose: Astella title-menu scenery and layout preview
scope: Preview only. No live Unity scene, prefab, profile or runtime changes.
inputImages: The two user screenshots informed composition analysis. They were not supplied as edit targets or copied into this package.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original full-screen title-menu environment background for the Korean 3D cooperative fantasy raid game ASTELLA. Generate a brand-new original environment illustration, not a UI screenshot. Landscape 16:9, 1920x1080 composition or wider high-resolution landscape. The game's established identity is restrained silver, amethyst and crystal resonance. Scene: a serene, mysterious crystalline sanctuary in a deep twilight valley, pale silver stone terraces and a winding path through luminous delicate violet-blue vegetation toward a monumental faceted amethyst crystal and elegant ancient broken stone arches on the CENTER-RIGHT. Strong depth with close dark foreground silhouettes, middle-distance stone path and vegetation, monumental right-side focal landmark and misty distant mountain layers. Rich stylized 3D game-render visual quality with painterly surfaces, sculpted geometry, cinematic volumetric atmosphere and soft silver dawn shafts. Deep indigo shadows, silver highlights, lavender crystal glow, restrained pale warm dawn rim light. The RIGHT two-thirds contain the memorable environmental focal point and interesting scenery; LEFT third is calm, dark low-detail atmospheric negative space suitable for a large logo in the upper left and a vertical list of six white menu labels below. Keep left readable naturally, no large rectangular shadow box. This is an original Astella landscape: do not reproduce the distinctive glowing giant tree or any branded screen of an existing game. Subtle floating light motes and crystal reflections are welcome. No characters, no animals, no logos, no letters or typography, no interface buttons, no menus, no version numbers, no credits, no watermarks. Beautiful immersive full-bleed scenery, no borders, no panels.
